title: Oboro Bunshin
body:
Syntax: perform oboro bunshin <target>

Description: Illusory clones that can confuse the target and lower accuracy.  Illusory clones lower the victim's accuracy. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 24-29. 80% chance to inflict confused. The effect lasts 20 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 17. Costs 18 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
